title: major-handoff.sh — invocation, the evidence it requires, the exit contract

pr_read.description: the answer of `gh pr view <pr> --repo <slug> --json state,labels,reviews,commits` (field names as recorded in worlds/pr-handoff/): every field the gate reads; an answer lacking one is unreadable (exit 4, nothing written)

pull_commits_read.description: the raw answer of `gh api repos/<slug>/pulls/<pr>/commits?per_page=100`: which commit of the PR read is a merge commit (two or more parents; glossary.md merge commit). Issued only when the gate reaches the approval-at-head check; an answer lacking a field, or an element for a commit of the PR read, is unreadable (exit 4, nothing written)

approval_at_head.description: reviewer bot ([bot] suffix normalized) APPROVED, submittedAt > newest non-merge commit

headings.description: each a line-anchored `## …` heading or `**…**` label, case-insensitive

upstream_line.description: `unchanged (<v>)` arms; anything else, or absent, parks

oneOf.description: handed off (major/awaiting-human added, agent/in-progress removed, re-read) OR armed (packaging-only chart major)
REFUSED — nothing written; the migration evidence is missing
UNREADABLE — a probe failed before any write
end state NOT PROVEN — writes issued, re-read does not show them
